meta.title: Persona Routing Hub
meta.description: Multi-bot persona routing hub: injects the current persona on the web, and resolves one persona for other platforms by bot × private/group × target cascading. Texts live in $DSH_HOME/persona-hub/prompts/<key>.txt and metadata in meta.json; no network requests, no memory writes. Disabling the plugin stops web injection and keeps existing assets.
